name: cannon_a
prompt: A single heavy black iron cannon on the deck of an old wooden sailing ship fires once with a deep thunderous boom and a burst of white smoke, then the smoke drifts away in silence. Audio: one loud deep cannon shot with a booming low rumble echoing over the sea, nothing else.

name: cannon_b
prompt: Close view of an 18th century naval cannon firing a single shot from a gunport, a huge flash and cloud of gunsmoke. Audio: a single powerful deep cannon blast, a heavy low boom with a short rumbling echo, then quiet.

name: cannon_c
prompt: A muzzle-loading ship's cannon recoils as it fires a single round, smoke billows from the muzzle over the waves. Audio: one sharp explosive gunpowder bang followed by a deep rolling boom, then silence, no voices.

name: cannon_d
prompt: At sea, the side of a wooden warship erupts as a single great gun fires, white smoke rolling over the water. Audio: one deep booming cannon shot with thunder-like low end, fading echo.

name: hitwood_a
prompt: A cannonball smashes into the thick wooden hull of an old sailing ship, splintering planks and timber flying through the air. Audio: a violent loud crack and crunch of breaking wood, splintering timber, debris clattering, then silence.

name: hitwood_b
prompt: Close view of a heavy iron ball crashing through a wooden ship's railing, shattering the planks into splinters. Audio: one loud impact, a heavy thud and sharp cracking of splintering wood, then quiet.

name: splash_a
prompt: A cannonball plunges into the sea next to a ship and throws up a tall column of white water. Audio: one heavy deep water splash, a plunging sploosh and spray falling back into the sea, then calm.

name: splash_b
prompt: A heavy iron ball drops from the sky into the open ocean, making a big splash and a fountain of spray. Audio: a single loud splash into deep water with falling droplets.

name: fire_a
prompt: Close view of flames burning on the wooden deck of an old ship at night, timber crackling and glowing embers rising. Audio: steady crackling and popping of a burning wood fire, roaring flames, no voices, no music.

name: fire_b
prompt: A campfire of dry wooden planks burns steadily, flames licking and sparks popping. Audio: continuous crackling fire, snapping wood and soft roar of flames.

name: bell_a
prompt: A polished brass ship's bell hangs on the deck of an old sailing ship and is struck twice by its clapper. Audio: two clear ringing strikes of a brass ship's bell, ding, ding, with a long resonant ring fading out.

name: bell_b
prompt: Close view of a brass ship's bell on a wooden belfry rung twice by a rope. Audio: two bright metallic bell strikes in quick succession, each ringing and decaying, then the hum fades.

name: waves_a
prompt: The deck of an old wooden sailing ship gently rolling on a calm sea, ropes swaying, waves lapping against the hull. Audio: gentle ocean waves washing against the hull, soft wind, the creaking of wooden timbers and ropes of the ship, calm and peaceful ambience, no voices, no music.

name: waves_b
prompt: Inside the hold of an old wooden ship at sea, lanterns swaying as the ship rocks slowly. Audio: steady sea ambience, water sloshing against the hull outside, timbers creaking and groaning softly, light wind.

name: shanty_a
prompt: Sailors on the deck of an 18th century sailing ship play a lively sea shanty on fiddle, accordion and a small drum while the ship rolls on the waves. Audio: an upbeat instrumental sea shanty folk tune with fiddle, concertina and stomping rhythm, no singing.
